name: ScrollFocusList
description: A large-type list inside a smooth-scroll viewport where the entry nearest the center is sharp, bright, scaled up and underlined in the accent color, while every other entry blurs and dims continuously with its distance from center.
a11yNotes: The viewport is a focusable role="region" labelled by the title, so keyboard users can Tab to it and scroll with arrows/Page keys/Space (native) with a 2px :focus-visible outline. Entries are an ordered list of real text that stays in the accessibility tree regardless of blur; index numbers, the pinned title chip and edge fades are aria-hidden. Wheel input is smoothed only while the viewport can still move and is released at the edges so the page keeps scrolling; touch and scrollbar dragging stay native. Under prefers-reduced-motion the wheel is not intercepted and blur/scale are disabled (entries only dim).

propsApi.name: items
propsApi.default: ['Design in the browser', 'Prototype with real data', 'Review on any device', 'Ship behind a flag', 'Measure what changed', 'Learn and iterate', 'Repeat, faster']
propsApi.description: List entries; the one nearest the viewport center is in focus.

propsApi.name: title
propsApi.description: Small label pinned at the top; also the region's accessible name.

propsApi.name: blur
propsApi.description: Maximum blur in px applied to entries far from center.

propsApi.name: minOpacity
propsApi.description: Opacity of entries far from center (0 to 1).

propsApi.name: scale
propsApi.description: Scale of the focused entry (1 disables scaling).

propsApi.name: accentColor
propsApi.description: Accent color for the focused entry's index and underline.

propsApi.name: height
propsApi.description: Height of the component's own scroll viewport in px (width is always 100%).

propsApi.name: borderRadius
propsApi.description: Corner radius of the viewport in px.

propsApi.name: lerp
propsApi.description: Interpolation factor per 60fps frame for wheel smoothing (0.05 floaty, 0.3 snappy).

propsApi.name: wheelMultiplier
propsApi.description: Multiplier applied to wheel and trackpad deltas.

propsApi.name: smooth
propsApi.description: Enable smooth wheel scrolling; false (or prefers-reduced-motion) uses native scrolling.

propsApi.name: className
propsApi.description: Additional class merged onto the root element.

propsApi.name: style
propsApi.description: Inline styles merged onto the root element.
